verdict.rationale: Supabase docs describe self-hosting via Docker Compose specifically for users with data-residency/compliance needs, letting them run Supabase in their own chosen infrastructure/region, and SOC2/HIPAA compliance docs mention regional compliance controls. However, there is no evidence of an explicit region-selection feature for the standard hosted platform (e.g., picking a project's cloud region at creation) in this pack. missing for 10: explicit hosted-platform region-selection UI/API documentation, evidence of available regions list, independent confirmation of residency guarantees for hosted projects.
